parsed.rationale: Both `WXYCBackground.wxycBackgroundDark` (BackgroundGradient.swift:30) and `WXYCGradient.wxycBackgroundDark` (WXYCGradient.swift:31) are exact-duplicate computed properties living in the same package (WXUI). Neither is test, codegen, mock, or sample-app code. The duplication is almost certainly accidental — the same dark-background gradient value was defined independently on two different types. The cleanest Swift resolution is to extract the shared value into a single location within WXUI (e.g., a dedicated `WXYCColors` or `WXYCGradientTokens` namespace, or as a `static let` on whichever type is the canonical gradient type) and have the other type reference it, eliminating the redundant definition.
